# wikidata-pq

> Build Wikidata's JSON dumps into Parquet datasets on the Hugging Face Hub, split by language and sorted by id

wikidata-pq builds Wikidata's weekly JSON dumps into Parquet datasets on the Hugging Face Hub: labels, descriptions, aliases, sitelinks, claims, the labels the claims refer to, and entities, each split by language (or site) and sorted by id. These pages describe how to run it and what each part of the code does.

## User guide

- [Setup](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/guide/setup/index.md): Requirements, credentials and disk
- [Build a release](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/guide/release/index.md): Build a release from an official dump, end to end
- [Monitor and resume](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/guide/monitoring/index.md): Progress, state files, failures and resuming
- [Tuning](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/guide/tuning/index.md): Workers, group size and disk
- [Performance](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/guide/performance/index.md): Measured timings of a release
- [The philippesaade build](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/guide/source-copy/index.md): The older build from philippesaade/wikidata

## Reference

- [Reference](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/index.md): Map of the code, and the data flow
- [Configuration](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/config/index.md): Environment variables and constants
- [Dump and routing](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/dump/index.md): Download, split and route a dump (dump.py, scholarly.py)
- [Run loop and state](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/run/index.md): The run loop, worker pool and state (main.py, pool.py, state.py)
- [Processing](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/process/index.md): Turning a chunk's JSON into typed tables (process.py)
- [Partitioning](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/partitioning/index.md): Splitting tables by language (partitioning/)
- [Push](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/push/index.md): Groups, merge, upload and verification (push/)
- [Finalise](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/finalise/index.md): The finalise sequence (main.finalise)
- [Compaction](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/compact/index.md): Compaction on the Hub (compact.py)
- [Sort by id](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/sort/index.md): Sorting by id (sort_by_id.py)
- [claims_labels](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/claims-labels/index.md): claims_labels for a release (claims_labels.py)
- [Dataset cards](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/cards/index.md): Dataset cards (cards.py, card_stats.py)
- [Hub branches and promotion](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/hub/index.md): Build branches and promotion (hub.py)
- [Pull](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/pull/index.md): Downloading the philippesaade copy (pull/)
- [Scripts](https://lmmx.github.io/wikidata-pq/pr-preview/pr-132/reference/scripts/index.md): Scripts outside the package
